title: Lumbar back and abdominal EMG (%MVC) in static forward bending at six hand heights, no exoskeleton (luggage handlers)
subcategory: static posture EMG (forward bending, no load)

quantity.name: EMG amplitude
quantity.definition: median (Q1-Q3) over subjects of mean normalised EMG during hold; lumbar back = mean of IL & LL, abdominal = mean of RA & EO, bilateral

source.authors: Koopman AS, Näf M, Baltrusch SJ, Kingma I, Rodriguez-Guerrero C, Babič J, de Looze MP, van Dieën JH

protocol.summary: Static forward bending, arms vertically down, hands at 6 heights relative to upright hand height: 100% (upright), 95%, 80%, 60%, 20%, 0% (touching floor); knees straight (slight flexion allowed if floor not reachable); ~5 s hold; no hand load; WITHOUT exoskeleton condition only. Average values over hold. Bilateral surface EMG: rectus abdominis (RA), external oblique (EO), iliocostalis (IL), longissimus thoracis (TL), longissimus pars lumborum (LL), sites per Kingma et al. 2010 (levels/distances not stated). Lumbar back = average of IL and LL (and sides); abdominal = average of RA and EO. Normalisation %MVC; MVCs for back and abdominal muscles in supine posture (McGill 1991); band-pass 20-600 Hz, rectified, low-pass 2.5 Hz.
how_to_simulate: Scale model to a 175 cm, 83.6 kg male; no hand load
Impose static postures at the 6 hand heights with measured lumbar flexion (WITHOUT, Fig. 3: ~1/31/42/55/64/67 deg)
Compare mean activation of iliocostalis+longissimus lumborum (back) and rectus abdominis+external oblique (abdominal) with medians/IQR

subject_model.source: Koopman 2020b Methods 2.2 (mean of 10 males; 1.75 ± 0.07 m, 83.6 ± 16.2 kg)

protocol.notes: Back-EMG panel x-axis is labelled '25%' where the other panels say '20%' - assumed a labelling typo (20%). Medians printed under each box (integers). Text: WITH vs WITHOUT reduction of median back EMG 5.5 %MVC (22%) at 95% consistent with WITHOUT median 25.

extraction.from: Fig. 3 'Lumbar back muscle activity' and 'Abdominal muscle activity' WITHOUT (blue) boxes
extraction.uncertainty: printed medians ±0.5 %MVC; quartiles digitised ±0.5 %MVC (abdominal), ±1 %MVC (back); back Q1 at 100% uncertain ±1
extraction.check_notes: Pixel medians agree with printed integers (back 95%: 24.8 vs 25; 60%: 20.6 vs 21; abd 0%: 8.4 vs 8). Text check 22% of 25 = 5.5 %MVC reduction.

pass_rule.rule: model activation within Q1-Q3 of measured EMG
